purpose: FRONTERA supplier discovery pipeline. Entries are research leads only; listing a supplier here does not mean FRONTERA has applied, been approved, or has permission to use product feeds or affiliate links. Off-road supplier discovery now prioritizes actual vehicle modification, tire management, recovery, protection, power and trail-support equipment; rooftop tents remain shelter products, not off-road recovery products.

suppliers.name: Sea to Summit
evidence_notes: Official affiliate page states 10% commission and 30-day cookie.
Official affiliate page directs applicants to AvantLink.
Product range includes sleeping systems, tents and tarps, cookware, dry bags, water storage and water-sports accessories.
suppliers.next_action: After AvantLink publisher account verification, inspect merchant terms and apply if suitable.

import_rules: Do not import products from a supplier until FRONTERA is approved and the applicable feed or permitted product source is confirmed.
Do not treat affiliate program existence as evidence of product quality or technical suitability.
Keep retail facts, network approval status, feed access and FRONTERA fit verification as separate fields.
Only manufacturer-verified specifications may support trip-planner suitability claims.
Recheck commission, attribution, permitted traffic sources, brand bidding restrictions, feed terms and program status inside the live network account before activation.

Classify off-road inventory by its actual function (tires, suspension, protection, recovery, air management, power, lighting, tools); do not classify a rooftop tent or generic mounting bracket as recovery equipment.
